The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1936–1937''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[Be Quick 1887]] and [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[NEC Nijmegen]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[DHC Delft]], [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[SBV Excelsior]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[CVV Mercurius]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[HFC Haarlem]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[Hermes DVS]], [[KFC (football club)|KFC]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
